description:
[FREE] Live ledger of the TOLLBOOTH - the link that bills its readers.
levelsio found thousands of bots open any posted link within 0.4s; this
endpoint charges them $0.01 USDC per open via x402 on Base. Returns how
many machine readers have paid, total USDC collected, and the recent
payers with their on-chain settle txs. Human landing page:
https://agentpaystore.com/tollbooth/ - the paid endpoint is
https://agentpaystore.com/tollbooth/api/read ($0.01, HTTP 402 without X-Payment).
name: tollbooth_ledger
